title: Asahina Mafuyu — Dive Into Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
How was school today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Pretty normal.
Oh, there was a pop quiz for English...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I did fine.
I was prepared for it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I wouldn't expect any less.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That reminds me, I found a study guide that I thought you'd find helpful.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. A friend of mine told me about all these study guides that are out there since you want to go to medical school so much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Obviously, I couldn't really get them all but I got you one for today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll get you some more next time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have twenty study guides alone now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My bookshelf is almost full because of all the books she's been getting me.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Today, I have to do homework, see what's coming up for cram school and work on N25 stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I guess I should flip through this first...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm reading books that I have absolutely no interest in and don't even know what I actually want to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That pain's going to come back if I'm not careful...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You don't look well. Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to rest a little if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I've gradually been able to feel something since Kanade started helping me find the real me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I should go now...
There's something I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's like a small jewel, but it's so bright. I can't tell what it is...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel like I've seen this before somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It must be a fragment of a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: SEKAI are made out of feelings, but some feelings are yet to manifest as their own SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Not yet their own SEKAI...
I didn't know about that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is this a fragment of my feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, if you touch it, you'll...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(All these bookshelves...
There's no one here and I don't see a map anywhere either...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I came to SEKAI to get away from books, but I ended up in a sea of books...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The fragments of feelings that haven't yet become their own SEKAI can take you to places like here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There are so many books here. It's fun, isn't it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mizuki's been bringing me some books to read lately, like children's books and manga. I've been really enjoying them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's nice...
But for now, we should find the exit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, there's a bookshelf over here too...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Just for a little bit, okay?
